test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"are graded."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the present tense, so the correct verb form is **"are graded".**
 
• The subject in this sentence **"grammar concepts"** is plural so we need a plural verb in the past tense with it.
 
• **"Had graded"** is past perfect tense, which is not appropriate for this sentence.
 
• **"Is graded"** is singular present tense, which does not agree with the plural subject.
 
• **"Are grade"** is not a grammatically correct sentence.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 2.
 
• **Correct passage**:

The grammar concepts **are graded**__ systematically and explained with examples ______ (2) ______ by exercises. The writing section ______ (3) ______ abundant practice in functional and imaginative writing with necessary scaffolding to ______ (4) ______ learners. The listening and speaking sections have activities embedded in meaningful contexts that will encourage ______ (5) ______ to interact confidently in English.
